_comment: MEASURED. Read off page.getSharedPluginData('banding','spec') on the Figma page "Banding". Nobody wrote this by hand, so it cannot flatter the system. Regenerate with design/banding-export.snippet.js; verify with design/verify-bands.mjs.

sunken.use: quiet alternate; one luminance step from base

inverse-raised.use: internal step within a dark passage; only adjacent to inverse

rules.rule: No two consecutive bands share a fill
rules.fix: Merge into one band; do not stack padding

rules.rule: Never two inverse bands in a row
At most two inverse bands per page; base/sunken is the default rhythm
After an inverse band, return to base, not sunken
No borders, rules or shadows on a band seam
rules.note: revolut.com has zero box-shadow (measured). Full-bleed imagery is the only permitted seam treatment.

rules.rule: Two adjacent bands never both take feature
rules.fix: One of the two steps down to default

foreground.mechanism: inverted bands set an explicit mode on the 02 Semantic collection; all descendants inherit
foreground.note: action/accent-bg does not flip: white on #0666eb is 5.11:1 and passes on every band. fg/link does flip: #0666eb on black is 4.11:1, #6fa0ff is 8.15:1.

hero: Not a band scale. Content-led with a min-height; sets the tonal key and does not count toward the alternation.
open: Band rhythm (which band is which role, in what order) is downstream of the three case studies.
